title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
title_zh: AutoMaster：让同一个模型成为更好的教师，实现自主后训练
abstract_en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
abstract_zh: 任务成功并不能说明后训练应该强化哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹，也可能包含缺乏依据的假设、无效重复或流于表面的验证。作者提出 Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning，技能引导微调）：在教师生成轨迹时，用自然语言技能指令抑制不良习惯，并引导模型展现较少出现但有效的行为，再用所得轨迹微调目标模型。AutoMaster 将这一过程自动化，由 LLM 智能体分析轨迹、设计技能指令、筛选数据，并利用轨迹生成和目标模型评估的反馈改进干预。在 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务上，使用 4B 和 9B 目标模型进行评估；在教师模型、任务池、训练集规模和 SFT 配方不变的条件下，相比仅用无引导的成功教师轨迹训练的 Vanilla SFT，AutoMaster 的平均性能提升了 1.42–8.99 个百分点。消融实验和轨迹分析表明，无需更换教师模型，调整其生成轨迹时的行为就能改善教学效果。进一步实验发现，即使监督输出完全相同、评估时也不提供技能指令，在 SFT 阶段保留技能指令仍在全部六种设置中带来更高的平均性能，说明保留技能上下文可能有助于目标模型内化这些行为。
key_points_zh: 任务成功不等于轨迹值得照搬：成功轨迹也可能夹杂无依据的假设、无效重复和表面验证。
Skill-FT 在教师生成轨迹时使用自然语言技能指令塑造行为，再用生成的轨迹微调目标模型。
AutoMaster 由 LLM 智能体完成轨迹分析、技能设计和数据筛选，并根据生成与评估反馈调整干预。
在教师模型、任务池、训练集规模和 SFT 配方不变时，相比 Vanilla SFT，平均性能提升 1.42–8.99 个百分点。
监督输出不变且评估不提供技能指令时，训练中保留指令仍在全部六种设置中优于移除指令。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 系统利用执行轨迹和评估反馈设计技能干预，再用受引导轨迹更新目标模型；受控对比检验了这一方法的增益，但未表明改进机制本身也在演化。
